summary: Signed in to Odoo 17 at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ as admin, opened the Contacts app, created a new contact named "fwod99-n1 Bench Customer" with City "Benchville", and saved it. The saved record (res.partner id 44, URL .../web#...&model=res.partner&view_type=form&id=44) shows the name "fwod99-n1 Bench Customer" in the name field and "Benchville" in the City field; the saved-form control panel (Sales / Invoiced buttons and a single-record pager) confirms it was persisted rather than left in a draft form. (contact_type: default radio selection, unchanged)

text: In Odoo 17, create a new quotation in the Sales app for customer 'fwod99-n1 Bench Customer' (choose from the customer autocomplete dropdown, do not just type). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the catalogue via the product dropdown, quantity 3. Let Odoo fill the unit price and compute the untaxed amount. Save and report: the product name chosen, the unit price on that line, and the Untaxed Amount from the totals.

summary: Created a new quotation in Odoo 17 Sales for customer 'fwod99-n1 Bench Customer' — chosen by typing into the Customer autocomplete and clicking the 'fwod99-n1 Bench Customer' option in the dropdown (the list closed and the partner's City 'Benchville' rendered beside the field, confirming a real selection). Added exactly one order line by typing in the product dropdown and selecting '[FURN_6666] Acoustic Bloc Screens', then set quantity to 3. Odoo supplied the unit price itself: 295.00. Saved the quotation (S00021, sale.order id 21); the saved record shows the single line at qty 3.00 × 295.00 = Tax excl. £ 885.00 and the totals block reads Untaxed Amount £ 885.00 (TAX 20% £ 177.00, Total £ 1,062.00).

text: Open quotation S00021 in Odoo Sales and add a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product than 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' (choose via the product autocomplete dropdown), quantity 2, letting Odoo fill its price. Save and report the second product's name and the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals.
